verdict.rationale: Bevy is a plain Rust crate (bevy-docs-21) installed through cargo from crates.io (bevy-probe-rt-1), and its code-first workflow needs no editor for an agent to drive (bevy-probe-rt-2), so building and running Bevy apps from scripts or CI is plausible. The pack never documents a headless runtime mode or a CI recipe. The first-party Bevy Remote Protocol is mentioned only in passing, via community tooling. missing for 10: documented headless/windowless run mode (no renderer/window), CI setup guidance or examples, documentation of the Remote Protocol for automation, hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.
